scope: Region-bounded brush, 18 picture options, saved texture and stamps, and live rotating painted WebGL relief on both Creative Lab routes.

checks: all 18 pictures are available across three categories and a legacy blank sheet retains its background
real brush motion stays in its starting area, leaves outside pixels and the overlapping eye transparent, and undo works
fur layers over the chosen colour and a placed leaf remains on the canvas and after reload
WebGL relief renders the painted tiger, visibly rotates, resets and returns to the same drawing
Mosaic geometry and a rocket painted from the live bucket render in 3D and both return to 2D
